Screening Step Parameters

Source: R/parameter.R
screen_control.Rd

Creates a parameter object controlling the screening (recursive feature elimination) step of mf.

Usage

screen_control(
  drop_fraction = 0.25,
  keep_fraction = 0.5,
  mtry_factor = 1,
  mtry_rule = "auto",
  min_ntree = 500L,
  ntree_factor = 1
)

Arguments

drop_fraction

Fraction of features dropped at each RFE iteration. Default 0.25.

keep_fraction

Fraction of features retained per module after screening. Default 0.50.

mtry_factor

Multiplier applied to the mtry_rule's base value to derive mtry for each screening random forest (mtry = ceiling(mtry_factor * base), constrained to [1, p]). Default 1.

mtry_rule

How mtry is derived from the feature count p. "auto" (default) uses sqrt(p) for classification and p/3 for regression. "sqrt" uses sqrt(p) for classification AND regression. "p_over_3" uses p/3 for classification AND regression.

min_ntree

Minimum number of trees per screening forest. Default 500.

ntree_factor

Trees per forest = max(p * ntree_factor, min_ntree). Default 1.

Value

An object of class screen_control.

See also

select_control, mf

Examples

screen_control()
#> $drop_fraction
#> [1] 0.25
#> 
#> $keep_fraction
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> $mtry_factor
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $mtry_rule
#> [1] "auto"
#> 
#> $min_ntree
#> [1] 500
#> 
#> $ntree_factor
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "screen_control"
screen_control(drop_fraction = 0.1, keep_fraction = 0.3, min_ntree = 200)
#> $drop_fraction
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $keep_fraction
#> [1] 0.3
#> 
#> $mtry_factor
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $mtry_rule
#> [1] "auto"
#> 
#> $min_ntree
#> [1] 200
#> 
#> $ntree_factor
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "screen_control"
